scientific_scope: bounded library-sensitivity comparator on the already scored sea-urchin panel; it does not replace Label-A or claim independent truth

fixed_d_contract.threshold_policy: reuse the frozen six-species CAL threshold from the D checkpoint; no refitting or threshold change
fixed_d_contract.panel_policy: reuse the four fixed centered 1,048,576-bp regions and saved panel_regions.fa; no score- or label-based window selection
fixed_d_contract.label_a_policy: retain the original Label-A output and its results as the primary D record; this comparator is reported separately

comparator.library: Dfam 3.9 FamDB uncurated lineage-specific families for taxon 7668
comparator.label_contract: strict D class buckets; only LINE/SINE/LTR/DNA/RC/Retroposon enter primary T1, other classes remain audited
comparator.output_role: separate library-sensitivity comparator; not a replacement for Label-A

resource_contract.large_file_policy: export, annotation, and cache-only rescore all run through Slurm
